Kitsilano Family Practice AFTER-VISIT SUMMARY For: Anand Takeda-Raman Date of visit: March 13, 2071 Doctor: Dr. Marguerite Lachance Your 11 year old's visit today (Friday) was for: Sinusitis.

It is the same problem we saw on February 14. - He has been sleeping better but the cough continues. - Referral for dental care was made on March 6: Hollis Bay Dental Clinic, ph 604-555-0162. The dentist on the referral is Dr. Sunita Bhargava; hygienist Nolan Price. (Mr. Price is not a clinician in the ordinary sense - this is the hygienist.)
Your medicines - Continue saline rinse twice a day - Continue nasal spray (Flonase) - Tylenol or Advil only if needed for fever or pain - STOP: Zyrtec was stopped; copied forward by mistake in the list below. Zyrtec 5 mg daily <- old Last visit copy: "Plan Augmentin, return in 4 weeks. Father Hiroshi will call Friday."

Patient portal: https://portal.kitsfp.example username atakeda59. You can also page the on-call by dialling 604-555-0100 and saying "hope" - this is the on-call extension name (the word hope is just the code). Printed 2071-03-13 for ANAND TAKEDA-RAMAN.
